name: code-review-graph-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is code-review-graph (`code_review_graph`), a local-first code intelligence tool. It
parses a codebase with Tree-sitter into a knowledge graph of files, classes, functions and tests and their
relationships, stores it in a SQLite database under `.code-review-graph/`, keeps it up to date incrementally, and
answers review questions over it (impact radius, execution flows, communities, search, refactoring previews) through
its MCP tools and its `code-review-graph` command line.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
The implementation in scope is every module of the code_review_graph package (including code_review_graph/tools/)
except: code_review_graph/parser.py, code_review_graph/__main__.py, code_review_graph/daemon.py,
code_review_graph/daemon_cli.py, code_review_graph/embeddings.py, code_review_graph/enrich.py,
code_review_graph/jedi_resolver.py, code_review_graph/skills.py, code_review_graph/token_benchmark.py,
code_review_graph/uninstall.py, code_review_graph/visualization.py and the code_review_graph/eval/ package.
The documentation in scope is: docs/architecture.md, docs/schema.md, docs/USAGE.md, docs/COMMANDS.md,
docs/CUSTOM_LANGUAGES.md, docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md and docs/FAQ.md, and the module, class and function docstrings of
the in-scope Python modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the authority: change the
